subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these refreshed third-party action commits across secret-bearing, security-scanning, release, and agent workflows after upstream-source and exact-head validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but immutable SHA changes replace executable supply-chain code inside privileged workflows; repository policy and the protected security label require a human to accept that trust-boundary change.

options.title: Verify and approve pins
options.body: Refresh the branch, confirm each SHA and relevant upstream contract, and approve after the sensitive exact-head workflows pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Land ordinary setup-action updates separately while reviewing token, Codex, security-scanning, and release actions in smaller batches.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Pause the batch until Dependabot access, upstream provenance, and the failing exact-head gate are resolved.

recommendation.title: Verify and approve pins
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, confirm each SHA and relevant upstream contract, and approve after the sensitive exact-head workflows pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They have broad workflow history, introduced a central affected agent workflow, and are directly engaged on this protected cross-repository automation decision.
